{"metadata":{"description":"Per-model capability declaration for DeepSeek Harness: reasoning-effort levels (wire spellings) + request modalities (vision) for OpenAI-compatible providers. Settings section, zero runtime harness deps, no YAML.","id":"gh:1333948630","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"better-model-provider","slug":"sanshanya/better-model-provider","topics":["ai-providers","deepseek","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","reasoning-effort"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Per-model capability declaration for DeepSeek Harness: reasoning-effort levels (wire spellings) + re"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"quest modalities (vision) for OpenAI-compatible providers. Settings section, zero runtime harness de"},{"id":"p1s3","text":"ties (vision) for OpenAI-compatible providers. Settings section, zero runtime harness deps, no YAML."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# better-model-provider"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"Sparse, non-destructive per-model overrides on official-catalog routes — including reasoning-effort "},{"id":"p3s2","text":"levels and their wire spellings — without replacing the catalog."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**Custom models: edit declarations. Official models: edit overrides. Provider configuration remains "},{"id":"p4s2","text":"dels: edit declarations. Official models: edit overrides. Provider configuration remains official.**"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"中文"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Why"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"The official Models page edits a model's input types and token capacities, but it does so by rewriti"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"ng that route's whole `models` array: one field touched, and every other model on the route stops fo"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"llowing the catalog — and sparse `modelOverrides` becomes illegal there. It also has no control for "},{"id":"p7s4","text":"per-model reasoning effort."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"This page is the other seam. On an official-catalog route it writes only the difference for the mode"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"l you touched — including `reasoningEfforts` levels and their wire spellings — and leaves the rest o"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"f the catalog following upstream. On your own declared routes it edits the declarations directly."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"dsh plugin --profile web add better-model-provider"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"The npm package ships ready-built, so this path never builds locally. Alternates: `github:sanshanya/"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"better-model-provider#master` (CI republishes ready-built artifacts to the `master` branch on every "},{"id":"p11s3","text":"green main push), or the default branch (`github:sanshanya/better-model-provider`), which builds fro"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"m source and prints one pnpm `allowBuilds` key to add, then rerun `add`; a local `link:` install mus"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"t `npm install && npm run build` first. Restart `dsh web`, and the Settings sidebar gains **Model ca"},{"id":"p11s6","text":"l && npm run build` first. Restart `dsh web`, and the Settings sidebar gains **Model capabilities**."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"dsh plugin --profile web rm better-model-provider"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Use"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"1. Configure the provider and API key on the official **Models** page first — keys and route lifecyc"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"le are always managed there; this page does not repeat them.
2. Expand a model row and edit its capa"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"bilities:
- **Reasoning effort**: pick **Custom**, check the levels you need; to offer "off" too, ch"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"eck `off` (its wire value may stay blank).
- **Vision models**: check `image` under input modalities"},{"id":"p14s5","text":" — otherwise sending an image to this model gets refused.
- **Capacities**: K/M spelling reads best "},{"id":"p14s6","text":"(`380K`, `1M`). Tap Apply and the change takes effect at once.
3. Official-catalog routes: tap **Man"},{"id":"p14s7","text":"age official models** and edit. Every change here stores only the difference from the official defau"},{"id":"p14s8","text":"lt — everything else keeps following catalog updates; **Reset to official defaults** undoes all of o"},{"id":"p14s9","text":"ne model's edits at once.
4. **Manage official providers (N)** unfolds installed-but-unconfigured ro"},{"id":"p14s10","text":"utes: pick one, apply the first change, and the route comes into being (its API key still goes on th"},{"id":"p14s11","text":"pply the first change, and the route comes into being (its API key still goes on the official page)."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"The official Models page can also edit input types and capacities — but only by replacing a route's "},{"id":"p15s2","text":"whole model list, which stops that route following the catalog and rules out overrides. Use this pag"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"e when you want one model changed and the other thirty-seven still following it. Once a route's list"},{"id":"p15s4","text":" *has* been replaced on the official page, this page edits that list like any declared route."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Dedicated-adapter apps (built-in DeepSeek / OpenAI Codex) declare their capabilities on their own se"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"ttings pages and never appear here."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"| Harness line | Status |"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"| `dsh 0.2.0-rc.2` (npm `latest` / `next`) | verified end-to-end |
| `dsh 0.2.1-alpha.1` | verified "},{"id":"p19s2","text":"end-to-end |
| `dsh 0.1.7-rc.2` | verified end-to-end |
| `dsh 0.1.5-rc.3` | verified end-to-end |
|"},{"id":"p19s3","text":" `0.1.2-alpha.1` … `0.1.6-alpha.2` | **not verified** — admitted by the peer ranges, no lane has run"},{"id":"p19s4","text":" on them |
| `0.1.0-rc.7` … `0.1.1-rc.2` | refused: no `connection.api` generation here any more |"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Verified means both lanes on a real harness: integration boots a checkout and serves the plugin's cl"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"ient module, functional drives a real browser through a capability write and its revert. They are op"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"t-in — `BMP_DSH_DIR=/path/to/deepseek-harness npm run test:live` (see `CONTRIBUTING.md` for the func"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"tional lane) — and skip without it."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"The peers are a single interval, `>=0.1.2-alpha.1 <0.3.0`: the floor keeps the retired `connection.a"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"pi` generation out (the `0.1.0-rc.7` line stays refused), the ceiling admits the dsh `0.2` line. Wha"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"t actually rules on them at install time is dsh's admission gate — it reads prereleases with `includ"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"ePrerelease: true`, and that is the path every install of this plugin takes; npm's own peer rule rea"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"ds the tuple more strictly and disagrees on some versions, but it never governs that path. (Through "},{"id":"p21s6","text":"0.0.6 the range was enumerated per published line — a residue of npm's stricter reading; 0.0.7 conve"},{"id":"p21s7","text":"rged it on dsh's semantics.) The nightly canary re-proves the `latest`, `next` and `alpha` channels,"},{"id":"p21s8","text":" and a leg whose channel resolved but whose lane skipped fails the run instead of passing quietly; w"},{"id":"p21s9","text":"hen a leg turns green again it closes that channel's accumulated red-tracking issues itself."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Field overlap: this page edits per-model `reasoningEfforts` (levels and their wire spellings) and sp"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"arse `modelOverrides` — the official Models page has no control for either. It also edits `input`, `"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"contextWindow` and `maxTokens`, which the official page edits natively, so those are a convenience h"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"ere rather than a unique capability. Recovery: if the official page rewrote a route's whole model li"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"st while overrides saved here linger beside it, write validation rejects the route — the card offers"},{"id":"p22s6","text":" **Remove leftover overrides**, one explicit click, never automatic."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"MIT"}],"truncated":false}
